d: Android to PS Vita port of Raging Thunder 2
ld: Unofficial port of **Raging Thunder 2** (Polarbit, Android, APK v1.0.16) to the PS Vita. It runs the unmodified ARM game library `librthunder2lite.so` (`armeabi`) through a native loader (TheFloW's so-loader + FalsoJNI), with rendering via vitaGL.
req:
- > Disclaimer: this project contains no game assets. You must provide your own legally obtained copy of the game
- > Game files are never distributed. You always need your own legally obtained copy of the game.
